issues.on_page: Budget and Actual schedule p9: Property Taxes 259,877 + In Lieu of Tax 5% 315 = 260,192
issues.issue: The statement's 'Property Taxes' 260,192 (p4) includes 315 of in-lieu-of-tax according to the all-funds budget schedule. The printed tax-type label wins, so keeping it as property tax is defensible. A person could choose to split out 315 as In Lieu of Tax (split_from) instead. The same applies to detail General Fund Property Tax 137,189.

Mixed grants/donations label with no printed breakdown. The Statement of Activities (p2) counts it in Operating Grants and Contributions. Grants and donations are separate categories and the grantor is unknown, so the category is a judgment call (same for detail General Fund Grants/Donations).

Mixed fees/permits label with no breakdown. Licenses and permits is defensible. The Statement of Activities puts these amounts in Charges for Services (1,988 general government + 110 community development + ...).
This is sales tax remitted on utility sales, not a tax refund or treasurer fee. The detail list has no closer fit; the category is Other Taxes Paid, which is consistent.
This cost-type line (utility bills) has category 'utilities' but no function: 'utilities' field, unlike the other cost-type lines (the same applies to detail Water/Sewer 'Utilities').
